2. Tab navigation and keyboard input

5. Different admin URL patterns (/admin, /admin/, /index.php/admin)
6. Direct access to CMS page editor (/index.php/admin/cms_page)

The login form appears to have a non-standard implementation where the input fields are not accessible through normal browser automation.
